_about: Light presets by light condition: key (sun / moon colour), fill (frontal fill colour), leak (the colour shadows let through), haze (far distance colour). The four template sets (day, golden-hour, dusk, night) are measured, with intensities and grades in references/look.md section 8; the rest are starting values. No subject colours here on purpose: derive the palette from the brief and its references (references/palettes.md section 3, references/gallery.md).

day.use: a clear day: mild warm key, warm frontal fill (the 3D template's day set)

golden-hour.use: low warm key against a COOL fill, long shadows (the template's golden set)

dusk.use: low warm key, violet fill, lit windows (the template's dusk set)

night.use: pale-blue moon, warm lamp pools (the template's night set)

hard-noon.use: white-hot high sun, dusty rose-violet fill (salt flats, white stone, beaches; warm sand keeps warm umber shadows)

snow-bright.use: warm-white key, cold blue fill and shadows (snow, ice, high mountains)

mist.use: soft key, teal fill, a far haze (misty forests, marsh, rain)

aquatic.use: cool clear light, teal fill and shadows (coasts, shallow seas, under water near the top)

overcast.use: neutral key, cool grey-blue fill (cities, machines, cloudy days)
